Question: Identify the conclusion of the following argument. We shouldn't abolish capital punishment. If we do, prisons will become more crowded. If prisons become more crowded, then we will have to build more prisons. And we don't want to build more prisons.

Options: 
A. We shouldn't abolish capital punishment.
B. If we do, prisons will become more crowded.
C. If prisons become more crowded, then we will have to build more prisons.
D. We will have to build more prisons.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
